future_requirement: Active information-seeking must be causal, not decorative.

uncertainty_condition.description: Candidate must face uncertainty before query/action and trace must show multiple latent social or preference states remain possible.

query_choice_condition.description: Query/action must be selected by candidate policy path, not injected by harness defaults.

observation_changing_condition.description: Query must change received observation, feedback, or available evidence.

state_update_condition.description: Received feedback must update serialized candidate state through candidate update path.

later_action_condition.description: Updated state must change at least one later action or policy distribution relative to no-query or shuffled-feedback counterfactual.

future_replay_requirement: Replay must recompute both action and state update.
